WHERE m.business_status = 1
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dish d JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.id = d.category_id WHERE d.merchant_id = m.id AND d.status = 'ON_SALE' AND ( d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM category_nutrition cn WHERE cn.category_id = d.category_id AND cn.nutrition_tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM setmeal s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.status = 'ON_SALE' AND ( s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dish d WHERE d.merchant_id = m.id AND d.status = 'ON_SALE' AND d.category_id = #{categoryId} )
AND 1 = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dish d WHERE d.merchant_id = m.id AND d.status = 'ON_SALE' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM setmeal s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.status = 'ON_SALE' )
